question: How much tax does Alice have to pay in 2018?
text: Bob is Charlie and Dorothy's son, born on April 15th, 2015. Alice married Charlie on August 8th, 2018. Alice and Charlie's gross income in 2018 were $324311 and $414231 respectively. Alice, Bob and Charlie have the same principal place of abode in 2018. Alice and Charlie file jointly in 2018, and take the standard deduction.
